cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark per-position accuracy at step 18630: Prefix reranker versus Baseline
cc:Work.dc:description: Fourteen exact logged values at the shared final step 18630. Latest wall-time record wins for repeated steps. Display positions 1–7 correspond to input files acc-pos0 through acc-pos6. Gain equals Prefix reranker accuracy minus Baseline accuracy in percentage points.
